preserved: Room UUID/task/actor identity and direct visibility
Draft scopes and exact command journals
Unknown receipts and explicit retry identity

native.ownership: Separately launched read-only disposable emulator; original AVD state not persisted
native.providers: Only synthetic team and transcript fixtures; no model, real audio provider or push
native.outcomes: Retained duplicate-title room drafts, exactly one membership PUT, unknown membership reconciliation, native typed direct sends/reply targeting, preserved voice origin/receipt, native Codex Enter send without replay after uncertain delivery, readable session activity states and in-place child disclosure
failuresAndCorrections: Intermediate room-actions bottom sheet lost native membership tap without a submission. Stable test bounds alone did not fix it. Replaced stacked modal transitions with the shared existing anchored session dropdown; both native membership journeys then passed.

A rerun against a reused transcript fixture counted the earlier run plus the current request. Grouped run failed its composer count assertion while both card methods passed. Restarted only the owned synthetic fixture; isolated Codex composer case then passed. No grouped-suite pass is claimed.

visualReview: Inspected actual synthetic room screenshot from final team native journey: existing mic and inline draft/send panel, plain agent message, existing usage/actions dock, compact context header. No motion or physical-device claim.
limits: Qualification variant only; release/debug shrinking and lint not run
Synthetic native methods do not qualify real-provider behavior or physical-phone UX

Room membership and recipient controls remain backend-specific menu slots
